Results for the 3rd Quarter of 2026 
We present the consolidated results for the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), the period from July 1 to 
September 30, 2026. The accounting information was prepared in accordance with accounting practices 
adopted in Brazil, in compliance with the CPC pronouncements and converged with the IFRS standards 
issued by the IASB. 
 
The Company is an ‘asset-light’ logistics company that holds a long-standing client portfolio, numerous 
business partner franchises, and the expertise and technology to lead banking items logistics in the 
country. It also operates in the B2B segment, providing logistics for large companies within the national 
territory. 
 
Net revenue was R$ 146.5 million in 3Q26 (R$ 137.8 million in 2Q26). The comparison with 2025 reflects 
the closure of B2C logistics (e-commerce) in April 2026, an operation that was not profitable. Since 
then, revenue has been concentrated in banking items and B2B logistics.

3Q26 
 
3 
 
Gross margin reached 24.5% in 3Q26 (18.4% in 2Q26), with gross profit of R$ 35.9 million (R$ 25.4 
million in 2Q26). In 9M26, gross margin was 17.1% (6.6% in 9M25), reflecting the concentration of 
revenue in the banking items and B2B logistics lines following the closure of the B2C operation. In 
addition to the closure of B2C, the margin improvement stems from the commercial team’s efforts to 
bring in new clients and increase share/volumes with existing clients, the management of contractual 
SLAs (e.g., reductions in late-delivery penalties), the expansion of our own network to serve more 
remote locations, and the work of a new pricing and margin management team. 
 
We also worked to keep costs at competitive levels through productivity/scale gains, reduced 
absenteeism among our employees, and the launch of tools that increase the productivity of couriers 
hired by franchisees (e.g., a routing app for couriers and a system to help franchises manage their 
performance indicators). 
 
The margin improvement can be seen in the table below:

Accounting EBITDA was R$ 21.3 million in the quarter (R$ 29.5 million in 2Q26). Adjusted EBITDA 
totaled R$ 27.1 million in 3Q26 (R$ 24.1 million in 2Q26), with a margin of 18.5% on net revenue 
(17.5% in 2Q26). 
 
The loss was R$ 25.1 million in 3Q26 (loss of R$ 7.2 million in 2Q26), of which depreciation and 
amortization, including the portion recorded in costs, accounts for R$ 11.9 million in 3Q26 (R$ 15.6 
million in 2Q26), plus R$ 9.4 million of present value adjustment in 3Q26, both with no immediate cash 
effect. 
 
Core operating cash, arising from recurring operations and excluding extraordinary receipts and cash 
allocated to the payment of legacy liabilities, amounted to R$ 1.0 million in 3Q26 and R$ 39.6 million in 
9M26. Core operation generation was R$ 24.0 million in 3Q26 and R$ 53.2 million in 9M26, of which R$ 
9.4 million was used to cover the loss-making B2C operations until their sale in April 2026 (see Cash 
Generation and Allocation). 
 
 
3Q26 
 
4 
 
Revenue Quality and Competitive Position 
Flash Courier is the market leader in banking items logistics, with 6.9 million deliveries per month and 
coverage of 1,606 municipalities as of the reporting date through its network of delivery franchises. The 
average 12-year relationship with its main banking clients provides predictability to revenue streams. 
Carriers operates in B2B logistics, combining proprietary technology, its own team and more than 400 
registered partners. Pricing is done per project/charter, which reduces exposure to volume variations. 
We do not operate with volume risk in less-than-truckload (LTL) freight and have closed our national 
networks, focusing on logistics projects that address the specific pain points of large companies. 
 
Gross revenue was R$ 167.6 million in 3Q26 (R$ 157.6 million in 2Q26), concentrated in banking items 
(82.4% of the total) and B2B logistics (16.9% of the total). E-commerce logistics (B2C) was closed in 
April 2026 and ceased to generate recurring revenue, which improved the Company’s revenue mix.

In 3Q26, we highlight the following initiatives in the banking items revenue line: 
1. Start of operations of a new DC for POS terminal logistics in Barueri; 
2. Expansion of the DOC+E service as an alternative to Correios for remote locations. This service 
is cheaper than the similar Correios service, capturing better margins and expanding Flash 
Courier’s own network together with the POS terminal logistics strategy; and 
3. Acquisition of two new sorters to increase the capacity for sorting and routing bank cards by 
destination/franchise by 20% starting in early 2027. 
 
3Q26 
 
5 
 
Banking items revenue was R$ 138.1 million in 3Q26 (R$ 137.8 million in 2Q26). The negative change 
compared to the same period of 2025 results from the insourcing of card logistics by a marketplace and 
the closure of a financial institution’s activities at the end of last year. The quarterly change reflects a 
3.5% increase in delivery volume with a reduction in the average ticket due to lower use of Correios by 
Flash itself. 
 
Since the amount charged to clients for reposting through Correios is higher than the amount charged 
when we use our own network, migrating from Correios to our own network reduces the average ticket 
of our revenue, but generates a higher margin and allows us to expand our own network by opening 
new franchises or serving new ZIP codes (CEPs). This approach will continue to be adopted in the coming 
quarters so that we can expand our own network, meeting a demand from our clients, as well as enabling 
the capillarity required in the POS terminal logistics business line. 
 
The average volume of card deliveries has remained close to 6.9 million per month, with fluctuations in 
months of major client campaigns (March), during the 2026 World Cup (June) and in months with fewer 
business days (February). 
 
 
 
 
 
We also routed 0.9 million banking items for clients in the quarter (4% of sorter volume), charging only 
for this service, since the posting is done by the clients themselves at Correios. 
 
POS terminal logistics is still at an early stage, but the Company has opened a new DC in Barueri and 
an experienced team from this segment has already been hired to lead the growth of this logistics 
through the franchises and the card logistics network. 
 
B2B logistics revenue was R$ 28.3 million in 3Q26 (R$ 19.7 million in 2Q26), due to the resumption of 
growth in this business line using the Carriers brand for new contracts, mainly with marketplaces. 
Carriers’ differential lies in its technology and in the management of each shipment tied to compliance 
with legal obligations, such as adherence to the ANTT minimum freight rate. A total of 18,456 trips were 
made in 3Q26 (11,496 in 2Q26).

1590512.s: Desdobramentos sobre o Grupamento - Leilão de Frações
1590512.texto:
1 
 
 
SEQUOIA LOGÍSTICA E TRANSPORTES S.A. 
Companhia Aberta de Capital Autorizado - Código CVM n° 25.160 
CNPJ nº 01.599.101/0001-93 | NIRE nº 35.300.501.497 
COMUNICADO AO MERCADO 
 
Grupamento de Ações – Realização do Leilão de Frações 
A SEQUOIA LOGÍSTICA E TRANSPORTES S.A. (“Companhia” ou “Sequoia”) (B3: 
SEQL3), em cumprimento ao disposto no artigo 157, parágrafo 4º, da Lei nº 6.404, de 15 
de dezembro de 1976, conforme alterada (“Lei das S.A.”), e na regulamentação da 
Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (“CVM”), em especial a Resolução CVM nº 44, de 23 de 
agosto de 2021, conforme alterada (“Resolução CVM 44”), em continuidade às 
deliberações da Assembleia Geral Ordinária e Extraordinária realizada em 02 de outubro 
de 2026 (“AGOE”), comunica aos seus acionistas e ao mercado em geral o que segue: 
Conforme aprovado na AGOE, foi realizado o grupamento da totalidade das 6.370.488.672 
(seis bilhões, trezentos e setenta milhões, quatrocentas e oitenta e oito mil, seiscentas e 
setenta e duas) ações ordinárias, nominativas, escriturais e sem valor nominal de emissão 
da Companhia, na proporção de 150 (cento e cinquenta) ações ordinárias para formar 1 
(uma) nova ação ordinária, nos termos do artigo 12 da Lei das S.A., sem alteração do 
valor do capital social da Companhia, que passou a ser dividido em 42.469.924 (quarenta 
e dois milhões, quatrocentas e sessenta e nove mil, novecentas e vinte e quatro) ações 
ordinárias, nominativas, escriturais e sem valor nominal (“Grupamento”). 
Encerrado, em 02 de novembro de 2026, o prazo concedido aos acionistas para ajuste de 
suas posições acionárias em lotes múltiplos de 150 (cento e cinquenta) ações, as ações 
de emissão da Companhia passaram a ser negociadas exclusivamente grupadas a partir 
de 03 de novembro de 2026. 
Em decorrência do Grupamento, as frações de ações foram separadas e agrupadas em 
números inteiros, totalizando 3.633 (três mil, seiscentas e trinta e três) ações ordinárias 
(ISIN BRSEQLACNOR2), sendo 3.613 (três mil, seiscentas e treze) ações provenientes de 
frações custodiadas na Central Depositária da B3 S.A. – Brasil, Bolsa, Balcão (“B3”) e 20 
(vinte) ações provenientes de frações registradas no ambiente escritural. 
A totalidade das 3.633 (três mil, seiscentas e trinta e três) ações ordinárias será alienada 
por meio de leilão a ser realizado na B3, por intermédio do Itaú Unibanco S.A., em 17 
de novembro de 2026, durante o leilão de fechamento do pregão. 
O produto líquido obtido com a venda dessas ações será rateado e distribuído 
proporcionalmente entre os titulares das frações de ações, em data a ser oportunamente 
informada pela Companhia, da seguinte forma: 

2 
(a) acionistas com dados cadastrais completos: os valores serão depositados na conta 
corrente indicada no cadastro do respectivo acionista junto ao escriturador; 
(b) acionistas com ações depositadas na Central Depositária da B3: os valores serão 
creditados diretamente à Central Depositária, que se encarregará de repassá-los 
ao respectivo acionista por meio de seu agente de custódia; e 
(c) demais acionistas não identificados ou sem dados cadastrais completos: os valores 
ficarão à disposição na Companhia, pelo prazo legal, para recebimento pelo 
respectivo titular mediante fornecimento de dados cadastrais completos. 
Os recursos atribuídos aos investidores (residentes e não residentes) poderão estar 
sujeitos à incidência de imposto de renda sobre eventuais ganhos, que serão tributados 
como “ganhos líquidos”, conforme a legislação vigente, podendo haver hipóteses de 
isenção conforme a natureza do investidor. Desse modo, o tratamento tributário adequado 
deverá ser identificado diretamente pelos respectivos acionistas e seus assessores. 
A Companhia manterá seus acionistas e o mercado em geral informados sobre o resultado 
e a conclusão do leilão. 
Barueri/SP, 17 de novembro de 2026.
